source: Home Office, Control of Immigration: Statistics, United Kingdom: 1985 (Cmnd 9863) Tables 15-16 for 1975-85 and 1988 (Cm 726 series, Sam's upload HO1988.pdf) Tables 18-20 for 1978-88 (1986 revised). Persons subject to immigration control accepted for settlement. 1975-85 citizenship split: old Commonwealth / New Commonwealth excl. Pakistan / foreign incl. Pakistan (Pakistan a foreign country 1972-89); 1986-88 split as published: old Commonwealth / Indian sub-continent + other New Commonwealth / foreign excl. Pakistan (columns new_commonwealth_and_pakistan, foreign_excl_pakistan). special_voucher_holders = British Overseas citizens (UK passport holders, mainly East African) admitted on arrival; uk_born_grandparent = Commonwealth citizens with a UK-born grandparent (ancestry route) accepted on removal of time limit; refugees_se_asia and work_permit_4yrs from Table 18 (1978-).
